scope: Chamber-level tallies and national vote reported by news organizations between 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-10. Compiled manually from public pages; source bytes were not archived, so these figures are context for the post-election review, not inputs to race-level scoring and not certified results. Outlets use different call rules and update times, so ranges are shown where they disagree.

uncalled.status: Peltola led Sen. Dan Sullivan by about 2,500 first-choice votes on Nov 9; ranked-choice tabulation pending.
Colom led Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by roughly 3,000 votes with about 98% counted on Nov 10; county certification deadline that week.

uncalled.status: Holscher led Ty Masterson by about 5,500 votes on Nov 4; close-race audit ordered; not called as of Nov 6.

governors.note: Democrats were reported to hold 28 governorships nationally (KS and AK pending); 6 Democratic governors were not on the 2026 ballot, so 22 of the 36 elections were called for Democrats.
